item.title: Noise-resilient training of machine learning interatomic potentials
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
The accuracy of machine learning interatomic potentials suffers from reference data that contain numerical noise. Often originating from unconverged or inconsistent electronic-structure calculations, this noise is challenging to identify. Existing mitigation strategies, such as manual filtering or iterative refinement of outliers, require either substantial expert effort or multiple expensive retraining cycles, making them difficult to scale to large datasets. Here, we introduce a noise-resilient training method that automatically down-weighs noisy samples, without requiring additional reference calculations. By tracking the loss distribution via an exponential moving average, this unsupervised method identifies outliers throughout a single training run. We show that this approach prevent…

item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
The Tognetti–Cortona–Adamo (TCA) correlation functional, and their subsequent variants, constitutes an important family of nonempirical generalized gradient approximations that have found successful applications in molecular and solid-state electronic structure calculations. In this work, we present a systematic assessment of the original TCA functional together with the revTCA, gracTCA, and transTCA variants within nonempirical hybrid (TCA0) and double-hybrid (TCA-QIDH) frameworks. item.title: Cooling down trees for finite-temperature quantum dynamics: Purification within ML-MCTDH
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
Simulating multidimensional quantum systems at finite temperature is inherently challenging as the system is no longer described by a single, pure-state wavefunction but by a density operator, squaring an already exponential scaling of the Hilbert space. Building upon the compact wavefunction ansatz of the multi-layer multiconfiguration time-dependent Hartree (ML-MCTDH) method, we present a new scheme for simulating finite-temperature quantum dynamics based on purification. Here, a density operator is mapped to a single ML-MCTDH wavefunction in an enlarged Hilbert space, comprising physical and auxiliary degrees of freedom. In the key step, one obtains a pure-state representation of the canonical density operator via imaginary time-propagation of the infinite-temperature state. The most i…

item.description:

👤 Ismail Adegbola Akintayo, Rasik Manve, Jatis Kumar Dash, Sabyasachi Mukhopadhyay
了解层状电极材料中的电荷存储需要将电化学动力学与电极积累电子电荷的固有能力区分开来。在这里，使用电化学测量和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算研究了相纯 Bi2O2S，以建立这种关系。循环伏安法、恒电流充放电和电化学阻抗谱揭示了强烈的速率依赖性电荷存储响应，在 1 A g-1 时比电容为 866 F g-1。扫描速率依赖性给出的平均 b 值为 ~ 0.61，而 Dunn 分析表明，扩散依赖性过程主导着电荷存储响应。

item.description:

👤 M. Asadzadeh, E. Ghoreyshi, B. N. Saray
The accurate computational solution of the time-harmonic Maxwell equations remains a central challenge in computational electromagnetics due to the indefinite nature of the double curl operator, the presence of spurious modes, and the high computational cost of resolving oscillatory solutions at large frequencies.
